question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beat.line: The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI customer data.
beat.headline: $1.5B
beat.action: The document folds into a stack of paper coins; a cutout screen rises behind it and holds.

sources: The $1.5B acquisition adds AI-driven customer data capabilities to Diginex's sustainability and compliance platform — transforming it from a point solution into an integrated end-to-end platform.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: soft violet. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: soft violet.
Subjects: a stack of paper coins; a cutout screen.
Opens on the document, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The document folds into a stack of paper coins; a cutout screen rises behind it and holds.
Ends holding on the screen.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$1.5B".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "$1.5B". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI customer data.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, modern editorial paper collage, photographed flat under soft room light from the upper left. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a soft violet block-color paper ground. In the upper third, a cream paper chip with a bold black sans-serif headline "REVENUE SYNERGY" is visible. In the lower two-thirds, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a document with rough white torn edges rests atop a cream paper ribbon. Immediately upon the first frame, the "REVENUE SYNERGY" chip slides rapidly upward and off-screen, while the document cutout begins to fold and collapse into itself with a fast, rhythmic motion, transforming into a neat stack of black-and-white halftone paper coins. Simultaneously, a new cream paper chip with the bold black text "$1.5B" lands with a slight overshoot from the top of the frame, settling firmly in the upper third. Behind the stack of coins, a black-and-white halftone cutout of a blank, unmarked computer screen with rough white torn edges rises vertically from the bottom of the frame, coming to a stable halt. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout. Every element—the violet ground, the coins, the screen, and the "$1.5B" chip—features a matte printed paper texture with visible print dots and casts a small, soft shadow to the right, consistent with the upper-left lighting. The final two seconds hold on this composition, with a subtle, barely perceptible loop of the coins shifting slightly. A warm, clear, natural male narrator (S1), speaking at a brisk but unhurried pace, says: <d>[English] The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI customer data.</d>

overall_soundscape: The audio features the crisp, tactile sounds of paper manipulation, including a rhythmic paper-slap as the document folds and the distinct, sticky sound of adhesive tape as elements land and lock into place. These diegetic sound effects are layered beneath the narrator's voice.
